release_readiness_rationale.pypi_release: BLOCKED — version inconsistency (pyproject=0.1.0 vs git tag=v0.1.0-alpha) ambiguous to pip; release.yml publishes to PyPI without running pytest first; ruff has 17 regressions (scripts/ added without lint coverage); SSRF in A2AHttpTransport unmitigated.
release_readiness_rationale.docker_release: Multi-arch image pushed and anon-pullable. Base image (python:3.12-slim) is floating-tag not digest-pinned; PyInstaller version unpinned; no SHA256SUMS for image layers; otherwise functional.
release_readiness_rationale.homebrew_release: BLOCKED — formula sha256 is stale ('744375fb…' vs actual '1ad26fcf…'); URL points at wrong owner ('macworkers' instead of 'merchloubna70-dot'); depends on PyPI being live (also blocked).
release_readiness_rationale.production_enterprise_use: BLOCKED — A2A HTTP SSRF (HIGH); MCP autodev_deliver_project/autodev_run_issue tools shell-out without server-side guardrail (MEDIUM); no LICENSE file at repo root (compliance); no CHANGELOG.md; release.yml lacks pytest gate; ReleaseFlow + MilestoneFlow zero test coverage.

release_blockers.title: Homebrew formula sha256 mismatch
release_blockers.detail: Formula has sha256=744375fb... but local sdist sha256 is 1ad26fcf...; brew install will reject with checksum error
release_blockers.fix: Regenerate formula sha256 from the actual CI-built release sdist after PyPI publish

release_blockers.title: Homebrew formula URL wrong owner
release_blockers.detail: Formula points at github.com/macworkers/autodev-ai but git remote is github.com/merchloubna70-dot/autodev-ai; every brew install will 404
release_blockers.fix: Update url in packaging/homebrew/Formula/autodev-ai.rb to merchloubna70-dot

release_blockers.title: macOS .app Info.plist version mismatch
release_blockers.detail: Info.plist says CFBundleShortVersionString=1.0 instead of 0.1.0; macOS Gatekeeper/Spotlight/Software Update will report wrong version

release_blockers.title: Version inconsistency: pyproject 0.1.0 vs git tag v0.1.0-alpha
release_blockers.detail: PEP 440 expects '0.1.0a1' or similar; current state makes the tagged release look like a stable 0.1.0 on PyPI which it isn't
release_blockers.fix: Either bump pyproject.toml to 0.1.0a1 and rebuild, OR retag to v0.1.0 (less honest)

release_blockers.title: No LICENSE file at repo root
release_blockers.detail: pyproject.toml uses inline license={text='MIT'}; GitHub license detection, PyPI badge, Homebrew formula all expect a physical LICENSE file
release_blockers.fix: Add MIT LICENSE file (1 click on github.com/.../new-license or copy from chooseit_open_source/MIT)

release_blockers.title: Release v0.1.0-alpha wheel/sdist missing --version flag
release_blockers.detail: Both dist/*.whl and dist/*.tar.gz attached to the GitHub Release were built at commit 09903e4 (before --version commit b5f8752). External users pip-installing from the Release get autodev exit-code 2 on --version
release_blockers.fix: Rebuild wheel+sdist from current HEAD (1b4f55c) and re-upload to v0.1.0-alpha Release, OR cut a new v0.1.0-alpha.1 tag and re-Release

release_blockers.title: A2AHttpTransport SSRF vulnerability
release_blockers.detail: A2AHttpTransport._make_request() passes endpoint URL directly to urllib.request.urlopen with zero scheme/host validation. file://, ftp://, 169.254.169.254 all accepted
release_blockers.fix: Validate scheme in {http,https}; reject private/link-local hosts; add tests

release_blockers.title: MilestoneFlow + ReleaseFlow zero test coverage
release_blockers.detail: MilestoneFlow backs `execute-milestone` CLI; ReleaseFlow backs `release-check` CLI; both have zero direct tests despite being public CLI entry points
release_blockers.fix: Add tests/unit/test_milestone_flow.py and tests/unit/test_release_flow.py at minimum smoke level

release_blockers.title: release.yml publishes to PyPI without running pytest
release_blockers.detail: Tagged commits ship to PyPI immediately even if tests are broken on that ref
release_blockers.fix: Add `needs: test` dependency in release.yml, OR inline pytest+ruff+mypy steps before twine upload

release_blockers.title: ProjectContextFlow orphaned (no tests, no docs)
release_blockers.detail: Backs the `generate-context` CLI command but no test file references the class and no doc page mentions it
release_blockers.fix: Add test + docs/tutorials/08-project-context.md OR remove the CLI command if not intended for users
